SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. S. B. REGISTRY / File No. H 507 / SECTION 2 Branch 133）
REPORT
Date July 5, 1933

Subject (in full) Letter from British Consulate-General re: Max Rund, German Communist.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the letter dated May 2, 1933
enclosing a photograph of Max Rund, German communist believed to
have visited Shanghai and Singapore in the summer of 1932, I have
to report that further enquiries have failed to elicit any infor-
mation regarding this individual's presence in Shanghai.

However, it is of interest to note that several per-
sons, including Mr. H. Gaetjen, Chief Chancellor of the local German
Consulate-General, who have been confidentially approached during
the course of enquiries, find a striking similarity between the in-
dividual appearing on the photograph in question and a local Ger-
man resident named Paul Metzner. In this connection the fact
must be kept in view that the photograph was taken in 1926.

Enquiries show that Paul Metzner is a German citizen,
born in 1891 in Prussia. He first arrived in Shanghai and was re-
gistered with the local German Consulate in 1914. After several
years' sojourn in this city he left for an unknown destination.
About 8 years ago he re-appeared in Shanghai coming either from
Manila or from Singapore. During the period from 1925 to 1928
he is believed to have resided in Tientsin where he was employed
for some time with Bremen Colonial & China Trading Co. According
to our information he has been residing in Shanghai since 1929
and was employed for short periods first with Dehn & Ebsen Inc.
(China Branch), 33 Kiangsi Road, and later with Reiss, Massey & Co.,
15 Museum Road. At present he is reported to be unemployed . He
is residing in House 2, No 219 Avenue du Roi Albert at which ad-
dress his wife, Mrs E. Metzner, keeps a boarding-house known as
" Pension Eden ".

During his sojourn in Shanghai Metzner did not come
to the notice of this office in connection with any political

报告
日期：1933年7月5日

事由（全称）：英国总领事馆来函，事涉德国共产党员马克斯·伦德。

制作人：D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人：（签名）

兹参照1933年5月2日来函，该函附有一张据信于1932年夏季访问过上海和新加坡的德国共产党员马克斯·伦德的照片，本人谨此报告，经进一步查询，未能获得任何关于此人在上海出现的信息。

然而，值得注意的是，包括本地德国总领事馆首席秘书 H. Gaetjen 先生在内的数人，在查询过程中被秘密征询意见，他们认为涉案照片中出现的人与一名名为保罗·梅茨纳（Paul Metzner）的本地德国居民有着惊人的相似之处。在此方面，必须考虑到该照片拍摄于1926年这一事实。

查询显示，保罗·梅茨纳系德国公民，1891年出生于普鲁士。他于1914年首次抵达上海并在本地德国领事馆登记。在本市逗留数年后，他前往一个未知的目的地。大约8年前，他再次出现在上海，来自马尼拉或新加坡。据信在1925年至1928年期间，他居住在天津，曾在不来梅殖民与中国贸易公司（Bremen Colonial & China Trading Co.）任职一段时间。根据我方掌握的信息，他自1929年起一直居住在上海，并先后短期受雇于江西路33号的 Dehn & Ebsen Inc.（中国分公司），以及博物馆路15号的 Reiss, Massey & Co.。据报道，他目前失业。他居住在阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）219号2室，其妻 E. 梅茨纳夫人（Mrs E. Metzner）在该地址经营一家名为“伊甸公寓”（Pension Eden）的寄宿寓所。

梅茨纳在上海逗留期间，并未因任何政治

REPORT
Date March 18, 1933.

MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY.
4561

Subject (in full) Enquiry from H.B.M. Consulate-General re:
Max Rund, German communist.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by W.B. Lu. D.I.

With reference to the letter dated February 15,
1933 from H.B.M. Consulate-General in Shanghai on the subject
of one Max Rund, xxxxx, an important German communist, who
is believed to have visited Shanghai during the summer of 1932,
enquiries at the Public Safety Bureau Passport Examination
Office show that prior to October 1932 no lists of foreigners
arriving in Shanghai from abroad were kept. Therefore, unless
the name of the vessel by which this individual arrived in
Shanghai or the date of his arrival is known, it is next to
impossible to find the passport examination form filled in
by him.

Lists of foreigners who arrived in Shanghai after
October 1, 1932 have been examined by the undersigned, as well
as enquiries have been made at various hotels etc., but no
trace of any person bearing the name Max Rund can be found in
Shanghai.

h2

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由（全称）：英王陛下总领事馆查询：德国共产党员马克斯·伦德。

制作人：D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫。 转呈人：W.B. Lu. 督察。

兹参照英王陛下驻上海总领事馆1933年2月15日来函，事涉一名名为马克斯·伦德的 xxxxx，重要德国共产党员，据信其于1932年夏季访问过上海，经向公共安全局护照查验处查询，显示在1932年10月之前，并未保存外国人从海外抵达上海的名单。因此，除非知晓此人抵沪乘坐的船名或抵达日期，否则几乎不可能找到他所填写的护照查验表。

下述签署人已查阅1932年10月1日之后抵达上海的外国人名单，并向各家旅馆等处进行了查询，但在上海未发现任何名为马克斯·伦德者的踪迹。

h2

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探警长

特别支部主管警官。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 11507
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
[印章文字模糊] SHANGHAI
15.2.33.

My dear Givens,

I have received information that an
important Communist by the name of Max Rund, born
February 3rd 1884, at Gleiwitz, was in Shanghai and
Singapore in the summer of last year.

By which route he arrived in Shanghai I
do not know, but I shall be most grateful if you
would be good enough please to enquire of the Chinese
Passport Authorities whether they have any record
of the arrival of such a man.

If so could you please obtain from
them the particulars as entered by Rund on the pass-
port form.

Yours sincerely,
[签名]

（左侧批注：DS? [签名] 2/19/2）

T. Givens Esq.,

（底部批注：JL For attention please
[签名] 16:2:33.）

1933年2月15日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

我获悉一名名为马克斯·伦德的重要共产党员，1884年2月3日出生于格莱维茨（Gleiwitz），于去年夏季曾在上海和新加坡。

我不知道他是通过哪条路线抵达上海的，但如果您能向中国护照当局查询他们是否有此人抵达的记录，我将不胜感激。

如果有，能否请您从他们那里获取伦德在护照表格上填写的详细信息。

此致
敬礼，
[签名]

[签名] 16:2:33.）
